title: Color Capsules
description:
Color Capsules is a competitive physics puzzle game where you launch, merge, and dodge cute gachapon capsules!

Aim to score the most points within the time limit, or time your combos to blow up your opponent (literally it'll send a big ol' bomb over.) Use your launch to shove stubborn capsules into place or find an angle you couldn't normally reach. No matter how full your board gets, it's not over until you get hit! Or, uh. The timer runs out.

Enjoy the colorful and stylish design as you play to best your friends, or sharpen your skills and technique in the single-player modes! If you tire of competition, the laid-back endless mode allows you to enjoy simply matching as many capsules as you can manage.

With all those points you've earned from playing, you can unlock customization options from the in-game gacha! There's over 100 different cosmetics to unlock, from your player dropper, to the gachapon contents, to the backgrounds, sound effects, music, and more!

featuring:

• a visual style that can best be described as incoherent (/positive)

• art from all my cool friends

• the metal pipe noise

• music from my cool friends. and also me.

• and also music you will remember from 2010s youtube videos

• the best physics in this type of game you have ever played with

• yelling "no way!" when you throw a 100k lead to try and turn it into a 110k lead and accidentally doink yourself

• my friend's cat
description_short: Stack 'em, merge 'em, hit 'em, dodge 'em! Color Capsules is a versus physics puzzle game where your gachapon capsules go flying! With a frantic pace and over 100 cosmetics to unlock, you'll always have something new to mess with!
